347:t_1:87.en:
???
「...Those who exist across many parallel worlds and have ruled history from the shadows in the name of watching over humanity's evolution... $$クロノ$$...」

347:t_1:88.en:
???
「But from within that $$クロノ$$, defectors calling themselves the Reformists appeared.」

347:t_1:90.en:
???
「One of them, $$破嵐創造$$, sought to accelerate evolution artificially and created the $$メガノイド$$, a new humanity with the will within humans... that is, the ego... strengthened.」

347:t_1:91.en:
???
「By sacrificing his own wife and son.」

347:t_1:92.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I see. So you're the one who disposed of them.」

347:t_1:93.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「To thank you for saving me the trouble, I'll let you tell me your name.」

347:t_1:95.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Heh... so you're the $$破嵐万丈$$ everyone's talking about.」

347:t_1:96.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$怨嗟の魔蠍$$, $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... I've heard about you, too.」

347:t_1:97.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What good is it for a nobody like you to know me?」

347:t_1:98.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$サイデリアル$$... I've already learned that you are $$クロノ$$'s superiors.」

347:t_1:100.en:
$$万丈$$
「I swear on this red earth. I will never allow you to exist.」

347:t_2:3.en: ～ $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, Hangar ～

347:t_2:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...So you guys really were thrown to the center of the galaxy!?」

347:t_2:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We were just as surprised.」

347:t_2:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「We split into two groups in subspace, but wherever each group got transferred to, it was one battle after another against $$バアル$$.」

347:t_2:7.en:
$$デュオ$$
「$$バアル$$, huh? You mean the $$宇宙怪獣$$ and the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s?」

347:t_2:8.en:
$$レド$$
「That's not all. We also encountered the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

347:t_2:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「We fought them as well. As you'd expect of a race fighting humanity for its survival, they were a formidable enemy.」

347:t_2:10.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Sounds like you had a battle every bit as fierce as ours.」

347:t_2:11.en:
$$桂$$
「Well... though the scale seems to have been way bigger on your side.」

347:t_2:12.en:
$$アルト$$
「Even so, we did gain something.」

347:t_2:13.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「The $$クォーター$$ joined up with $$バトル７$$ and surveyed the $$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins.」

347:t_2:15.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「The fleet that I and $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ belonged to. It seems we were drawn to them by the power of $$バサラ$$'s song.」

347:t_2:16.en:
$$カトル$$
「To think something like that could happen...」

347:t_2:17.en:
$$桂$$
「It's not unthinkable. $$バサラ$$'s songs have crossed space-time and caused outrageous phenomena before.」

347:t_2:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「Just as the $$クォーター$$ joined the fleet through $$バサラ$$'s song, the $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ met up with the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$, likewise transported by the $$ゲッター線$$.」

347:t_2:19.en:
$$桂$$
「$$ゲッター線$$, huh? Then the key person on your team must be $$竜馬$$...」

347:t_2:20.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「For the $$クォーター$$, it was at the $$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins; for the $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$, it was Dr. $$早乙女#getter$$, whom they met again through the guidance of the $$ゲッター線$$...」

347:t_2:21.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We obtained information about the collapse of the universe that comes once every 12,000 years.」

347:t_2:22.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Could that be the clash between the force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist?」

347:t_2:24.en:
$$カトル$$
「It matches Dr. $$トライア$$'s survey report.」

347:t_2:25.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Given this, there's no doubt that thing in the $$リモネシア$$ ruins is the real McCoy.」

347:t_2:26.en:
$$アルト$$
「We gained more than that. We found out that $$ブレラ$$, who'd been missing, was under the protection of the $$マクロス７船団$$.」

347:t_2:28.en:
$$クルツ$$
「(For the big brother of the Super Dimension Cinderella, he's awfully unfriendly.)」

347:t_2:29.en:
$$マオ$$
「(Still, he looks more like her than Major $$オズマ$$ would if you called him her brother.)」

347:t_2:30.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「$$ランカ$$'s brother is $$オズマ・リー$$. I'm merely related to her by blood.」

347:t_2:32.en:
$$マオ$$
「Wow, you've got some serious ears, you.」

347:t_2:33.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I'm a cyborg who received $$インプラント$$ treatment in the $$ギャラクシー船団$$.」

347:t_2:34.en:
$$宗介$$
「The $$ギャラクシー船団$$... The ones who tried to use the power of the $$バジュラ$$ in the $$再世戦争$$ and lost to $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.」

347:t_2:35.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「My mind was controlled, and I fought as one of their soldiers.」

347:t_2:36.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「But now that I'm free of that, I fight to protect $$ランカ$$.」

347:t_2:37.en:
$$桂$$
「OK, $$ブレラ$$. We'll be counting on you from now on.」

347:t_2:38.en:
$$アルト$$
「I finished repairing my $$ＹＦ－２９$$ with $$バトル７$$'s materials. I think I'll be a real asset in combat.」

347:t_2:39.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$ブレラ$$ isn't the only unexpected reunion.」

347:t_2:40.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Let me introduce her. ...This is $$シビル$$. She's a support member of $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$.」

347:t_2:43.en:
$$桂$$
「Girls like this are more than welcome.」

347:t_2:46.en:
$$桂$$
「W-we haven't even hit on you yet...」

347:t_2:47.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「$$シビル$$ is a 《$$プロトデビルン$$》, you know.」

347:t_2:48.en:
$$桂$$
「Hold on a sec! I heard about the $$プロトデビルン$$ from $$ガムリン$$ before. Aren't they the enemy that fought the $$マクロス７船団$$?」

347:t_2:50.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「After listening to $$バサラ$$'s song, the $$プロトデビルン$$ became able to regenerate $$スピリチア$$ on their own, so they no longer need to attack other living things.」

347:t_2:51.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「In short, they've become beings no different from us.」

347:t_2:52.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「We came under attack from the $$サイデリアル$$ and were driven into a corner, and then $$ゲペルニッチ$$, the leader of the $$プロトデビルン$$, appeared to help us...」

347:t_2:53.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$シビル$$ ended up coming along as support for $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$.」

347:t_2:54.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「When $$バサラ$$ sings 'POWER TO THE DREAM', $$シビル$$ joins in, too.」

347:t_2:56.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I get it this time. That's a cry of joy at meeting us, right?」

347:t_2:57.en:
$$桂$$
「I'm counting on you from now on, $$シビル$$. When things settle down, I'll show you around Earth's date spots.」

347:t_2:59.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ブレラ$$ and $$シビル$$ aren't the only ones we met again.」

347:t_2:60.en:
$$正太郎$$
「The $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ ran into $$グーラ$$ and $$ゼウス$$ at the center of the galaxy.」

347:t_2:61.en:
$$デュオ$$
「$$グーラ$$... You mean the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s son?」

347:t_2:62.en:
$$正太郎$$
「That's right. I hear $$グーラ$$ had come to the center of the galaxy to investigate the $$ゲッター線$$ and $$バアル$$.」

347:t_2:63.en:
$$甲児$$
「The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ who bound him is gone now, after all. He joined forces with us and fought $$バアル$$.」

347:t_2:64.en:
$$正太郎$$
「After the fighting ended, though, he went away.」

347:t_2:66.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$バアル$$ weren't the only ones we fought at the center of the galaxy. In our battles against the $$宇宙怪獣$$, we ran into the $$ミケーネ神$$s again.」

347:t_2:67.en:
$$宗介$$
「So they're the survivors of the ones we fought in the $$時獄戦役$$.」
